scripts.build:ios: npm run build && npx cap sync ios
scripts.icons: node --input-type=module -e "import sharp from 'sharp'; await sharp('public/logo-source.png').resize(512,512,{fit:'cover',position:'centre'}).png().toFile('public/icon-512.png'); await sharp('public/icon-512.png').resize(180,180).toFile('public/apple-touch-icon.png'); await sharp('public/icon-512.png').resize(32,32).toFile('app/icon.png');"
scripts.test: node --import tsx --test lib/gameScoring.test.ts lib/pairingMerge.test.ts lib/localSoloRun.test.ts lib/gameRules.test.ts
